Like counts are mutable, shared, cross-session product data — a case's named 'e.g.' example agent will not reliably show a specific like count from run to run. Automation must dynamically discover a card matching the needed starting state rather than hardcoding the example name from the case text. Not a defect (case text explicitly says 'e.g.').

The default post-refresh Agent Hub / Catalog view only renders the top-6 'Trending' cards (sorted by likes descending) — a freshly-liked LOW-count agent is not guaranteed to still be visible there after a page reload. Step 6's persistence check must re-locate the agent via the catalog-search-input rather than assuming it's still in the default unfiltered view.

Any case that likes an agent as part of its steps must unlike it again before ending (cleanup), because like state is shared product data that sibling family cases (ELITEA-2355 unlike, ELITEA-2364 My Liked filter, ELITEA-2365 reload button) depend on as a clean baseline. Encoded as a MANDATORY Cleanup section in this AFS rather than optional.
